mentl/1eb4dac:
Audit of the last ten commits, prompted by a direct question and confirmed by
measurement: all ten were net-POSITIVE in total lines, and splitting code from
comment showed the collapse commit (7e989493) — whose entire thesis is "four
nodes were one operation" — at net MINUS TEN code lines. It deleted ~165 and
added ~155. Reading it explains why.

It deleted four LowExpr constructors and immediately reintroduced the same
three-way branch as PdLexical | PdResolved | PdWalked — the lexical, singleton
and evidence tiers it had just removed, re-entered as an enum. The emit's
"ONE arm" then branched on them FIVE times, in the arm whose own comment said
no arm of the emit may differ on what the operation MEANS.

The axes are two, not three. WHERE THE RECORD AND WORLD COME FROM (the
install's own frame locals, or the walk's node) and HOW THE ARM IS REACHED (a
static symbol, or an index out of the record's slot). Three constructors over
two binary axes leaves the fourth combination representable and meaningless —
a PRODUCT encoded as a SUM, drift-8 at the type level. Nesting ArmTarget under
PdWalk makes (frame, slot) unconstructible: a frame answer knows the handler,
so it always knows the symbol.

  PdFrame(install, handler, op)
  PdWalk(effect key, op slot, op, ArmNamed(handler) | ArmSlot)
  PdDriver(fn)

PdSelfState is renamed PdDriver and stays, deliberately: it belongs in the
dispatch POSITION even though it is not a dispatch, and moving it to its own
LowExpr would have cost ~10 walker arms to save four — the deletion has to be
real, not relocated.

The handler and the op stay SEPARATE. A first pass at this fused them into the
symbol, which would have re-broken what an earlier commit in this same arc
fixed: visit_direct_perform fires from the emit walk and needs the handler
alone, the root census needs the op alone. perform_target_name spells the
symbol; nothing stores it.

And that projection is now an Option rather than "" — the empty string was a
constructor nobody n

mentl/1eb771d:
The parameter list / call-args become the product node-kind SYNTAX.md
mandates — labeled, positional, mixed, and default are the product's four
construction forms, ONE machinery with record literals (surpassing
Swift/Python's bolt-on labeled args + ML/Rust's separate param-pattern
grammar).

W15 — labeled call arguments. A `name = value` call arg parses to a
LabeledArg(name, value) node; resolve_call_args (types.mn) is the ONE read
both infer and lower call, so they see the identical positional order by
construction (the seam pattern — one truth, two consumers, no
re-derivation). It reorders labeled args by field name against the callee's
declared param names (E_UnknownArgLabel on a miss, productive-under-error),
fills absent fields with their param defaults, and strips the wrapper before
infer_expr/lower_expr. The old lower-only trailing-default fill
(lower_args_with_defaults / callee_params_of / lower_default_fills)
DISSOLVED into it — less code, one home.

W16 — destructuring parameters. A param IS a Pat: `((a, b)) => …` /
`({x, y}) => …` / `([h, ...t]) => …` desugars at fn entry to a fresh-named
param plus a `let <pat> = <fresh>` prepended to the body — byte-identical to
a destructuring let, the SAME match projection desugar_block gives. ONE
pattern machinery at let-bind AND param-bind; no TParam shape change, no new
infer/lower path. expr_to_param deleted (subsumed by expr_to_pat +
pat_param_and_let).

The LabeledArg node-kind gets its exhaustive-match arm in every full expr
enumeration (infer_expr / lower_expr / own count_uses+walk_return /
infer collect_resume + walk_refinement / lower collect_free_vars / oracle
expr_child_handles) — recursing into the value where it carries free
vars/resumes, a Located E_UnknownArgLabel where a wrapper leaks outside a
call (no silent fallback over a load-bearing ADT).

Both DIRECT value gates are .mn-leads — the disposable seed's parser lags
resolve_call_args AND the param desugar (TESTED: the seed parses `y = 3`

mentl/1e8ddce:
Lands the silence-predicate substrate per MV §2.7.5. Mentl does NOT fill
space to fill space — a VoiceLine surfaces only when proof_derivable AND
observation-new-since-last-turn both hold. Silence is the default;
speaking is the exception, earned by proof + novelty.

Residue (all pure over Situation, no effects):

  fn silence_predicate(situation) =
    proof_derivable(situation) && observation_new_since_last_turn(situation)

  fn proof_derivable(situation) =
    match situation.tentacle { ... 8 arms, exhaustive ... }

  fn observation_new_since_last_turn(situation) =
    None or topic-equal-and-tentacle-equal check

  fn topic_equal(a, b)       — exhaustive over 5 Topic variants
  fn tentacle_equal(a, b)    — exhaustive over 8 Tentacle variants (8 × 8)

Discipline applied beyond the spec:

- §2.7.5's `_ => false` wildcards converted to explicit per-Topic
  enumeration (H6 / drift mode 32). The wildcard would have masked
  AT10 (TopicError → TentPropose fires on codeAction) — exhaustive
  enumeration surfaces the case the spec hid.

- Helpers handle_is_hole / error_at / nested_calls_at_span are
  effect reads on graph state. TopicFacts hoists their results into
  Situation composition so silence_predicate stays pure: the handler
  that builds the Situation (lands in MV.2.e) performs the effect
  queries once and freezes them in TopicFacts. Fields derivable from
  existing Situation state (reason_at_topic, refinements,
  gradient_next, row_at_topic vs row_declared) stay on Situation —
  TopicFacts holds only the three truly-new computations
  (is_hole / error_code_at / nested_call_depth).

- Situation gains `prior_turn_tentacle: Option<Tentacle>` so the
  novelty check has both prior topic AND prior tentacle (spec
  references last_tentacle_for(prior) which would otherwise require
  an effect read).

Eight interrogations:

  Graph         — Situation IS the per-turn graph snapshot; predicate
                  reads only frozen fields.
  Handler       — silence_predic

mentl/1ec1d77:
Detect handler clauses where resume(expr) is the final action with no
state updates — these need no continuation. Skip the 6 Vec clones + Arc
wrap in op_perform and route through the Resume opcode instead.

Detection: is_tail_resumptive() walks the handler body AST at compile
time, checking for direct resume with pure args and no effect calls in
block statements. Conservative — returns false when uncertain.

VM-only optimization. The interpreter's continuation-based replay log
accumulates through continuation chaining; skipping continuations breaks
the chain for later non-tail-resumptive handlers. The VM's explicit
replay log doesn't have this coupling.

For compute_forward (4 tail-resumptive clauses, ~32K calls in XOR):
op_perform drops from full continuation capture to frame push only,
resume drops from full body re-execution to direct stack unwind.

1-bit image back into greys; the copier then halftones those greys and
the photo goes muddy. Dithering exists to hand the printer pure black
and white, so the panels and the log keep pixelated everywhere and the
override is gone.

pairs on the blue/orange axis and never on red/green, and the tray
outline that hint belongs to was already orange. It now matches, at
4.9:1 on paper. Red stays where it was before this branch: the one
destructive button.

Merge claimed to prefer the newer copy of anything held by both sides,
then quietly kept the local zine sheet regardless. A press edit now
carries a stamp like every other record and merges by the same rule,
so the claim in the settings copy is the behaviour.

the browser suites cover corrupt storage, partial backups, the v2
upgrade path, dangling photo references, an emptied log, sheet-merge
